parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: 331-model parameter beta; benchmark beta=+Sqrt[3] (arXiv:1611.09337, Table 1)

parameters.name: v1
parameters.description: rho-Higgs vev [GeV]; paper benchmark v1=200 GeV (Sec. 4, Figs. 5-7)

parameters.name: v2
parameters.description: eta-Higgs vev [GeV]; paper benchmark v2=143 GeV with v1=200 GeV, v=246 GeV

parameters.name: v3
parameters.description: chi-Higgs vev [GeV]; paper Higgs-fit benchmark v3=2 TeV (Sec. 3)

parameters.name: kappa
parameters.description: k in f=k*v3 with k~O(1), Sec. 2.1 Eq. (VHiggs)

parameters.name: lam3
parameters.description: quartic lambda3; M_H3^2 = 2 lambda3 v3^2 (mass-spectrum list, Eq. 5)

parameters.name: f331
parameters.description: f = k v3 with k~O(1) (Sec. 2.1, after Eq. VHiggs)

parameters.name: s12
parameters.description: s12 = v2/v (Eq. U)

parameters.name: c12
parameters.description: c12 = v1/v (Eq. U)

parameters.name: o11
parameters.description: CP-odd rotation O11 (Appendix B)

parameters.name: o21
parameters.description: CP-odd rotation O21 (Appendix B)

parameters.name: o31
parameters.description: CP-odd rotation O31 (Appendix B)

parameters.name: a0
parameters.description: a0 = sqrt(1-(1+beta^2) sW^2) (Appendix A, before Table 1)

parameters.name: ap
parameters.description: a_+ = sqrt(3) beta + 1 (Appendix A)

parameters.name: am
parameters.description: a_- = sqrt(3) beta - 1 (Appendix A)

parameters.name: gLZpE
parameters.description: Z' left coupling to charged leptons and neutrinos, L=rule/i of Table gauge-fermion

parameters.name: gRZpE
parameters.description: Z' right coupling to charged leptons (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gLZpU
parameters.description: Z' left coupling to u,c,d,s quarks (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gLZpT
parameters.description: Z' left coupling to t,b quarks (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gRZpU
parameters.description: Z' right coupling to up-type quarks (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gRZpD
parameters.description: Z' right coupling to down-type quarks (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gLZpDQ
parameters.description: Z' left coupling to heavy quarks D,S (Table gauge-fermion, L=rule/i)

parameters.name: gRZpDQ
parameters.description: Z' right coupling to heavy quarks D,S (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gLZpTQ
parameters.description: Z' left coupling to heavy quark T (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gRZpTQ
parameters.description: Z' right coupling to heavy quark T (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gLZpEL
parameters.description: Z' left coupling to heavy leptons E (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gRZpEL
parameters.description: Z' right coupling to heavy leptons E (Table gauge-fermion)

parameters.name: gLZpu
parameters.description: Z' chiral left couplings to up-type quarks (u,c from Table; t row)

parameters.name: gLZpd
parameters.description: Z' chiral left couplings to down-type quarks (d,s from Table; b row)

parameters.name: gRZpu
parameters.description: Z' chiral right couplings to up-type quarks

parameters.name: gRZpd
parameters.description: Z' chiral right couplings to down-type quarks

parameters.name: yHu331
parameters.description: H0 bar-u u Yukawa O21 m/v2 for u,c and O11 m/v1 for t (Table scalar-fermion)

parameters.name: yHd331
parameters.description: H0 bar-d d Yukawa O11 m/v1 for d,s and O21 m/v2 for b (Table scalar-fermion)

parameters.name: yHl331
parameters.description: H0 bar-l l Yukawa O21 m_l/v2 (Table scalar-fermion)

parameters.name: MZp
parameters.description: Z' mass^2 = cW^2 g^2 v3^2 / (3[1-(1+beta^2)sW^2]) (mass-spectrum Eq. 3)

parameters.name: MH3
parameters.description: M_H3^2 = 2 lambda3 v3^2 (Eq. 5)

parameters.name: MH0
parameters.description: M_H0^2 = (v1v2/v3+v1v3/v2+v2v3/v1) f (mass-spectrum list)

lagrangian_terms.name: LZpKin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, nu}, -1/4 FS[Zp, mu, nu] FS[Zp, mu, nu] + 1/2 MZp^2 Zp[mu] Zp[mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LVKin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, nu}, -1/2 FS[Vbbar, mu, nu] FS[Vb, mu, nu] + MV^2 Vbbar[mu] Vb[mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LYKin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, nu}, -1/2 FS[Ybbar, mu, nu] FS[Yb, mu, nu] + MY^2 Ybbar[mu] Yb[mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LNKQ
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, I DQbar.Ga[mu].DC[DQ, mu] - MDQ DQbar.DQ + I SQbar.Ga[mu].DC[SQ, mu] - MSQ SQbar.SQ + I TQbar.Ga[mu].DC[TQ, mu] - MTQ TQbar.TQ]

lagrangian_terms.name: LNKEL
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, ExpandIndices[I ELbar.Ga[mu].DC[EL, mu] - MElo ELbar.EL]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LNScal
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, 1/2 del[H2, mu] del[H2, mu] - 1/2 MH2^2 H2^2 + 1/2 del[H3, mu] del[H3, mu] - 1/2 MH3^2 H3^2 + 1/2 del[H0, mu] del[H0, mu] - 1/2 MH0^2 H0^2 + DC[Hpbar, mu] DC[Hp, mu] - MHp^2 Hpbar.Hp + DC[HVbar, mu] DC[HV, mu] - MHV^2 HVbar.HV + DC[HYbar, mu] DC[HY, mu] - MHY^2 HYbar.HY]

lagrangian_terms.name: LYukC
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{sp, sp2, ff, yuk}, yuk = HVbar (Sqrt[2] s13 MT/v1 uqbar[sp, 3].ProjM[sp, sp2].TQ[sp2] + Sqrt[2] c13 MTQ/v3 uqbar[sp, 3].ProjP[sp, sp2].TQ[sp2]) + HVbar CKM[1, 1] DQbar[sp].(-Sqrt[2] c13 MDQ/v3 ProjM[sp, sp2] - Sqrt[2] s13 MD/v1 ProjP[sp, sp2]).dq[sp2, 1] + HVbar CKM[2, 2] SQbar[sp].(-Sqrt[2] c13 MSQ/v3 ProjM[sp, sp2] - Sqrt[2] s13 MS/v1 ProjP[sp, sp2]).dq[sp2, 2] + HV ELbar[sp, ff].(-Sqrt[2] c13 MElo/v3 ProjM[sp, sp2]).vl[sp2, ff] + HY uqbar[sp, 1].(Sqrt[2] s23 MU/v2 ProjM[sp, sp2] + Sqrt[2] c23 MDQ/v3 ProjP[sp, sp2]).DQ[sp2] + HY uqbar[sp, 2].(Sqrt[2] s23 MC/v2 ProjM[sp, sp2] + Sqrt[2] c23 MSQ/v3 ProjP[sp, sp2]).SQ[sp2] + HY CKM[3, 3] TQbar[sp].(Sqrt[2] c23 MTQ/v3 ProjM[sp, sp2] + Sqrt[2] s23 MB/v2 ProjP[sp, sp2]).dq[sp2, 3] + HY ELbar[sp, ff].(-s23 yl[ff, ff] vev/v2 ProjM[sp, sp2] - Sqrt[2] c23 MElo/v3 ProjP[sp, sp2]).l[sp2, ff] + Hp CKM[3, 3] uqbar[sp, 3].(Sqrt[2] s12 MT/v1 ProjM[sp, sp2] + Sqrt[2] c12 MB/v2 ProjP[sp, sp2]).dq[sp2, 3] + Hp CKM[1, 1] uqbar[sp, 1].(-Sqrt[2] c12 MU/v2 ProjM[sp, sp2] - Sqrt[2] s12 MD/v1 ProjP[sp, sp2]).dq[sp2, 1] + Hp CKM[2, 2] uqbar[sp, 2].(-Sqrt[2] c12 MC/v2 ProjM[sp, sp2] - Sqrt[2] s12 MS/v1 ProjP[sp, sp2]).dq[sp2, 2] + Hp vlbar[sp, ff].(c12 yl[ff, ff] vev/v2 ProjP[sp, sp2]).l[sp2, ff]; ExpandIndices[yuk] + HC[ExpandIndices[yuk]]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LGg331
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, sp, sp2, ff, yc}, yc = ExpandIndices[-gw/Sqrt[2] (Yb[mu] (ELbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.l + uqbar[sp, 1].Ga[mu].ProjM[sp, sp2].DQ[sp2] + uqbar[sp, 2].Ga[mu].ProjM[sp, sp2].SQ[sp2] + CKM[3, 3] TQbar[sp].Ga[mu].ProjM[sp, sp2].dq[sp2, 3]) + Vb[mu] (ELbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.vl + TQbar[sp].Ga[mu].ProjM[sp, sp2].uq[sp2, 3] + CKM[1, 1] dqbar[sp, 1].Ga[mu].ProjM[sp, sp2].DQ[sp2] + CKM[2, 2] dqbar[sp, 2].Ga[mu].ProjM[sp, sp2].SQ[sp2]))]; ExpandIndices[Zp[mu] (gLZpE lbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.l + gRZpE lbar.Ga[mu].ProjP.l + gLZpE vlbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.vl + uqbar.gLZpu.Ga[mu].ProjM.uq + uqbar.gRZpu.Ga[mu].ProjP.uq + dqbar.gLZpd.Ga[mu].ProjM.dq + dqbar.gRZpd.Ga[mu].ProjP.dq + ELbar.gLZpEL.Ga[mu].ProjM.EL + ELbar.gRZpEL.Ga[mu].ProjP.EL + gLZpDQ DQbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.DQ + gRZpDQ DQbar.Ga[mu].ProjP.DQ + gLZpDQ SQbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.SQ + gRZpDQ SQbar.Ga[mu].ProjP.SQ + gLZpTQ TQbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.TQ + gRZpTQ TQbar.Ga[mu].ProjP.TQ)] + yc + HC[yc]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LTotal
lagrangian_terms.expression: LZpKin + LVKin + LYKin + LNKQ + LNKEL + LNScal + LYukH0 + LYukC + LGg331
